method: Full decoded skinned vertex comparison after identical paused clip seeks at baseYaw 0 and pi. Baseline world vertices are independently rotated 180 degrees about the world origin. Actor state is reset through paused seek; source sampler, solver and post-IK floor code are unchanged. Public actor inspection changes only heading/offset state.
limitations: Five static poses per selected identity and LOD; not every heading or stateful transition.
Grouping uses largest skin weight, not an anatomical segmentation. Rest-Y bins use original decoded POSITION.y.
Vertices shared across split material primitives are counted separately.
A partial diagnostic can remain valid for its exact served offline payload while raw source GLBs are being exported; complete/pass still require all disk guards.
No GPU or physical-phone performance measurement.
